mapper.select: SELECT c.id, p.nombre, p.telefono, p.email FROM cliente c JOIN persona p ON p.id = c.persona_id WHERE c.id = #{clienteId} AND c.deleted = FALSE AND p.deleted = FALSE

SELECT pr.id, CONCAT_WS(' ', p.nombre, p.primer_apellido) AS nombre, p.telefono, pr.empresa FROM proveedor pr JOIN persona p ON p.id = pr.persona_id WHERE pr.id = #{proveedorId} AND pr.deleted = FALSE AND p.deleted = FALSE
SELECT id, nombre, duracion_minutos AS duracionMinutos, precio_base AS precioBase FROM servicio WHERE id = #{servicioId} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT m.id, m.nombre, m.cliente_id AS clienteId, e.nombre AS especie FROM mascota m LEFT JOIN especie e ON e.id = m.especie_id AND e.deleted = FALSE WHERE m.id = #{mascotaId} AND m.deleted = FALSE
